text: One execution context's FontLab services, shared by all its import adapters. FontLabSession(ctx, version=...) joins the three issue-104 lanes for a script or plugin run in FontLab: L1 model and GlyphsApp facade ( fontlab_bridge ): Glyphs.menu is an AppMenu over the plugin host, DRAWFOREGROUND callbacks become after-native-layer editor painters, DRAWBACKGROUND callbacks paint before the native layer on builds with native canvas painters (else as an overlay, R054).
